_comment: Sources the FQHC Breach & Advisory Watch checks every run. Edit freely; the routine reads this file fresh each time. 'kind' is a hint for how to read the page.

sources.note: 500+ individual breaches under investigation, newest submission first. JS app: read it with `node fqhc-breach-watch/ocr_portal.js 2` (headless Chromium), not a page fetch. Listings lag submission by weeks. Fall back to web search only if the script fails.
Dated OCR press releases. hhs.gov returns 403 to curl; read with a fetch tool.
Check whether HC3 is still publishing; record if inactive.
Flag additions affecting EHR, practice-management, remote access/VPN, email, or identity products common in FQHCs.
Public threat-intelligence posts (infrequent). TLP:WHITE bulletins are mirrored on aha.org; use the H-ISAC search query to find them.
Feed: https://ago.vermont.gov/taxonomy/term/10/feed. As of 2026-11-11 the newest posted notice is dated 2026-04-10; record if still stale.
Table is filled by script; a plain fetch returns headers only. If rows do not load, record as failed and rely on search.
The list is the year-to-date PDF linked under '2026' on this page; download and read that PDF.

web_search_fallback: health center "notice of data security incident"
HHS OCR breach portal health center
H-ISAC TLP White threat bulletin aha.org
